mapping.summary: Captures supplier invoices with OCR, matches to orders, routes approvals and archives them.
claims: OCR reads invoice text and fills the matching BC fields
Three-way matching of invoices and credit memos against purchase orders and receipts
Auto-approves invoices and credit memos below a set amount
Routes documents to approval with a choice of three workflows
Approvers can review, approve, reject or hold documents from anywhere
Purchase contracts to check invoiced amounts and auto-approve linked documents
Full-text searchable archive of processed documents
Activation goes through a Dynamics partner
Works with BC Essentials and Premium
Exchanges electronic documents compliant with European and local rules, with XML support
Tracks each document from receipt to final posting
Archive certified in Germany as audit-proof
Available in 11 languages including Danish, German, French and Polish
